Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
	definition:
		overdueUsers: Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u: User|u.LoanedBook->exists(l: Loan|l.IsReturned = false and
		(l.OverDue3Days = true or
		l.OverDue10Days = true or
		l.OverDue17Days = true or
		l.OverDue31Days = true)))
	precondition:
		overdueUsers.isEmpty() = false
	postcondition:
		overdueUsers->forAll(u: User|if u.SuspensionDays>0 
		then u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays-1 
		else u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays 
		endif ) and
		overdueUsers->forAll(u: User|if u.SuspensionDays = 0 
		then u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::SUSPEND 
		else u.BorrowStatus = u.BorrowStatus 
		endif )
}
